scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained and separate from finite computations. An independent mathematical or originality audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns finite nonempty reflexive linear-preorder cluster chains with one forward modality and full Boolean operations.
It does not give a general sharpness result for the depth bound or for nonreflexive or non-linearly ordered frames.
Older modal-algebra antecedents may exist; full text of one relevant 2018 reference was not accessible in this comparison.
title: Adjacent-palette rigidity and exact generation census for finite S4.3 cluster chains
